basis.summary: All claims come from a single 2026 paper, so I relied on the directly measured infection-challenge results (inflammatory cytokines, serum enzymes, microbiota, histology) and not on the background or inferred claims, and I noted the mixed strain-specific results (JO26 Aeromonas, JO12 AKP) instead of presenting a uniform benefit.

statement_en: In crucian carp challenged with Aeromonas hydrophila, dietary Lactobacillus sakei (strains JO12, JO26, JO35) was measured to ease intestinal inflammation and tissue damage (lower TNF-α, IL-1β and MyD88, higher IL-10, less mucosal edema), lower serum acid phosphatase, raise lysozyme, and reduce Proteobacteria. Strains differed: JO12 and JO35 lowered Aeromonas abundance and corrected gut gene expression most, while JO26 did not lower Aeromonas, and JO12 raised intestinal alkaline phosphatase; JO35 was most often the best performer, all from one paper.
statement_zh: 在感染嗜水气单胞菌的鲫鱼中，饲料添加清酒乳杆菌（JO12、JO26、JO35）经测定可减轻肠道炎症和组织损伤（TNF-α、IL-1β和MyD88降低，IL-10升高，黏膜水肿减轻），降低血清酸性磷酸酶，提高溶菌酶，并减少变形菌门。不同菌株效果不一：JO12和JO35对降低气单胞菌丰度、纠正肠道基因表达的作用最明显，JO26未能降低气单胞菌丰度，JO12还使肠道碱性磷酸酶升高；总体上JO35表现最好。以上均来自同一篇论文。
